metadata.method: GEM's reference-rock PGA (10% probability of exceedance in 50 years) raster clipped to the regional extent, nearest-sampled on a 0.1 degree WGS84 grid and grouped into contiguous equal-class polygons. Severity stores the lower bound of each class in g. No-data pixels omitted.
